title: Write a task card
prompt: Complete the class TaskCard. The constructor takes a title and a number of minutes and stores them in Title and Minutes. Done starts as false, and Complete() sets it to true. Describe() returns "Pack (30 min)" for a card that is not done and "Pack (done)" for one that is.
hints: Which members does the constructor have to fill in, and from which parameters?
Property names start with a capital letter and parameter names do not. Title = title; stores the parameter in the property.
In Describe, test Done. Return the title with "(done)" when it is true, and with the minutes when it is false.
checkLabels: Title must hold the title passed to the constructor.
Minutes must hold the minutes passed to the constructor.
A new card must not be done.
A card that is not done must describe itself as "Pack (30 min)".
A card with 0 minutes must still show its minutes.
After Complete(), Done must be true.
A completed card must describe itself as "Pack (done)".

wrongAnswers.misconception: Forgets to store one constructor parameter.
Describes a completed card the same way as an open one.

feedback: Check each member in turn: what the constructor stores, what Complete changes, and which text Describe returns for each value of Done.
